news.headline: Wonderfruit moves a week earlier
news.detail: 3 to 7 December in Chonburi; five-day pass THB 10,900. Tomorrowland Thailand follows 11 to 13 December, sold out.

news.headline: Mandarin Oriental Makati opens late this year
news.detail: Ayala Triangle Gardens, with five dining and bar concepts still unnamed.

news.headline: Halloween weekend: every party, prices and door rules
news.detail: Thirteen parties from Poblacion to the bay, 31 Oct and 1 Nov, each with its source.

news.headline: The Palace runs four Halloween rooms in one night
news.detail: Dystera: Rogue at Clubhouse, La Fête at Medusa, YP 2099 at Yes Please, Babylon at Revel. 18 and over; passes on the Palace site.

news.headline: Madness Manor brings hard dance to Century City
news.detail: Ravecore and Hard Dance PH at Stratosphere Events Place; tickets on Ticket2Me, tables by DM.

news.headline: Intramuros throws a two-day Halloween street party
news.detail: INTRAMUMU, 31 October to 1 November, 4 pm to 2 am, ₱465 a day or ₱930 for both.

news.headline: LaLaLa Fest tickets go on sale for January
news.detail: Philippine Arena, 14 January 2027. General sale opened 17 October.

news.headline: Makati Central Square turns into a bar cluster
news.detail: El Gato, The Cattery and Fat Cat open in the basement and mezzanine, with Bando and +81 Bar alongside; Ferm and Good Games announced.

news.headline: Bar Leone is the world's best bar again
news.detail: The 50 Best Bars 2026, Milan: Hong Kong's Bar Leone first for a second year; no Philippine bar in the list.

news.headline: Bangkok named the world's best nightlife city
news.detail: Time Out's 2026 ranking from 24,000 residents: Bangkok first, Berlin second, New York third. Manila not listed.

news.headline: Ultramilk opens opposite Big Fuzz
news.detail: A punch-focused cocktail bar from Kyle Quismundo at Creekside Mall, Legazpi Village.

news.headline: Problem Child is the best bar in the Philippines
news.detail: No. 44 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026, eight months after opening on Jupiter Street. The Spirits Library placed No. 98.

news.headline: The Iron Fairies lands in BGC at twice the size
news.detail: The Hong Kong bar's Manila room on 20th Drive: nightly bands and DJs, six private rooms, by Habitat Hospitality.

news.headline: Always Welcome opens in Salcedo Village
news.detail: A neighbourhood cocktail bar by Royce Pua at Solar Century Tower.

news.headline: Manila gets a vinyl listening bar
news.detail: Kariton x Sabi Sounds at Tiffany Place, Salcedo: café by day, records and weekend DJs into the early hours.

news.headline: XYLO closes after seven years
news.detail: Closing parties 13 to 17 January; Clubhouse is the Palace's big room now.
